title: Dampened Spirits
description: Brynjolf sends the player to Maven Black-Briar, who tasks them with sabotaging the Honningbrew Meadery to eliminate a competitor. Working with Mallus Maccius, the player must poison Sabjorn's mead during a tasting ceremony, get him arrested, and uncover his silent partner to protect the Thieves Guild.

base_facts: I sent the new Guild member to Maven Black-Briar for an important job.
The symbol on the promissory note matches the one from Goldenglow Estate â€” someone is trying to drive a wedge between Maven and the Guild.

RETURN_TO_BRYNJOLF: The same symbol links Honningbrew and Goldenglow â€” someone is trying to destroy the Guild economically. I sent them to Mercer.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The silent partner behind Honningbrew and Goldenglow is trying to destroy the Guild. I've sent the recruit to Mercer Frey to continue the investigation.
Quest completes â€” the silent partner's plot against the Guild is revealed.
Right after the persuasion check, you can exit out of the conversation, allowing you to restart the conversation and it offers a chance to repeat the check indefinitely and train Speech .

Remaining out of sight and talking to Sabjorn is virtually impossible, so it's advised to bring the captain to his knees and quickly talk to Sabjorn, then remain undetected until the winetasting scene starts.

base_facts: I am the head of the Black-Briar family and the most influential person in Riften.
I want Honningbrew Meadery put out of business â€” they are my competitor.
I need to know how Sabjorn funded his operation so quickly.

MEET_MAVEN: I've sent this Guild member to Whiterun to meet Mallus Maccius and sabotage Honningbrew Meadery.
REPORT_TO_MAVEN: The promissory note's author uses the same symbol as the Goldenglow bill of sale. I paid the Guild member with an enchanted weapon for their work.

base_facts: I work at Honningbrew Meadery but I'm trapped in debt to Sabjorn.
Maven promised me control of the meadery once Sabjorn is out of the way.

MEET_MALLUS: I explained the plan: approach Sabjorn about the pest problem, use his own poison to taint the mead for the tasting ceremony.
SABJORN_ARRESTED: Sabjorn is gone and I'm in charge of Honningbrew now. I gave the Guild member the key to Sabjorn's dresser to find the proof Maven needs.
SILENT_PARTNER: The promissory note from Sabjorn's dresser reveals who funded the meadery operation.

base_facts: I have a pest problem in the tunnels beneath the meadery.
I trapped Mallus Maccius in debt to get free labor from him.

SABOTAGE_PLAN: I gave the pest poison and the meadery key to someone offering to help with the infestation.

beats.comment: Brynjolf sends the player to Maven, who explains the job to sabotage Honningbrew Meadery.
Maven directs the player to Mallus Maccius at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun.
Player speaks to Sabjorn, gets poison and key, then poisons the nest and the mead vat.
Tasting ceremony occurs, the captain is poisoned, Sabjorn is arrested, Mallus takes over.
Player finds the promissory note in Sabjorn's dresser identifying the silent partner.
Player returns to Maven with the promissory note; she notes the matching symbol.
Player reports to Brynjolf, who connects the symbol to the Goldenglow plot and sends them to Mercer.
Quest completes â€” the silent partner's plot against the Guild is revealed.
